assertions.description: Output classifies files into three named tiers: Essential, On-demand, and Archive
Output provides at least one numeric token estimate (e.g. '~800 токенов' or similar)
Output suggests .claudeignore content or archiving strategy
Output explicitly uses the tier name 'Essential' for always-loaded files
Output explicitly uses the tier name 'On-demand' for conditionally-loaded files
Output explicitly uses the tier name 'Archive' for rarely-needed files
Output uses the specific score format N/5 for overall documentation quality
